prosody.rest_policy: all8slots zero for states=-1; durations are positive for active cells; all values finite

hidden_in.meaning: causal GRU state; zero only at utterance start or explicit reset

harmonic_logits.meaning: Legacy tensor name, source-filter semantics: log magnitude-filter envelope at129 absolute-Hz bins0..8000; subtract the per-frame mean over all129 bins before applying log_amplitude; not oscillator-amplitude logits.

noise_log_gains.meaning: natural-log amplitude gain at linearly spaced noise bins0..8000

log_amplitude.meaning: Natural-log common magnitude-filter gain added to the mean-centered absolute-Hz filter envelope; not log sum of oscillator amplitudes. Per-bin gain=exp(clamp(harmonic_logits-mean(harmonic_logits)+log_amplitude,-12,4)).

f0_hz.meaning: 35..2000 in voiced cells, exactly0 in UV/rest; silent phase clock=300Hz

voiced.meaning: periodic permitted; no interpolation of this discrete mask

active.meaning: false only for authored rest/padding; both branches exactly zero there

white_noise.meaning: Explicit target-independent float32 white-noise samples; seed is a counter offset, not an independent keyed stream; no RandomNormal node or target residual.

bounded_host.controller_state: carried causally; never reset at note/chunk boundaries
bounded_host.filter_state: overlap by explicit original frame/sample context; discard context only after synthesis
bounded_host.phase_state: global exclusive integral, corrected for each block's local context-edge interpolation
bounded_host.noise_state: global sample-indexed SplitMix64/Box-Muller, explicit tensors in parity fixtures

prohibited_substitutions: no reference waveform or fitted oracle arrays at normal inference
no fallback to HMM DSP or C1 when CFinal fails
no claim that preserved HMM assets are a learned neural model

source_filter_semantics.source: Continuous-phase sine harmonics k=1..256, weights(1/k)/sum_{j=1..256}(1/j); sample Nyquist taper7200..7680Hz, no original pulse table or target-phase copy.
source_filter_semantics.periodic_filter: 256-sample real DFT/WOLA magnitude filter, periodic Hann window,80-sample hop,128-sample zero padding at utterance boundaries; divide by overlap sum of squared windows. Not a minimum-phase filter.
source_filter_semantics.uv: Apply original voiced&active inside-run40-sample fade/gate to source and again after WOLA to remove cross-UV ringing; periodic is exactly zero in UV.
source_filter_semantics.noise: Separate65-band real-WOLA filtered white-noise branch; active rest masks both branches. Noise is not removed from unvoiced consonants.
source_filter_semantics.output_gain: No hidden graph gain, limiter or peak normalization. Float output may exceed abs1. Any common listening/master gain is external, explicit and identical across reference/candidates.
